prompt: emacs define-modify-macro arglist disallowed parameter types
answer:
In Emacs `define-modify-macro`, `&key` is explicitly disallowed:

```elisp
(define-modify-macro NAME ARGLIST FUNC &optional DOC)
```

The `ARGLIST` may use `&optional` and `&rest`, but not `&key`. Aux variables are also unsupported. A `&rest` parameter can be used to pass keyword arguments through to the function.
